name: gatekeeper
description: Your open PRs and what each waits on (/gates): the template boxes only you can tick, CodeRabbit threads and change requests, Codecov, CI, conflicts and drafts ready for you, sorted so what needs you comes first. A band above the prompt counts them; Claude can ask through the gates tool.

query.title: Search
query.description: The GitHub search for your PRs.

yourBoxes.title: Boxes only you tick
yourBoxes.description: Words that mark a PR-template checkbox as yours to tick (case-insensitive substrings).

pollMinutes.title: Refresh every (minutes)
pollMinutes.description: How often to read GitHub. Every session shares one read (~/.cache/crab-workshop/gatekeeper.json), so this is how often GitHub is asked at all, not per session; 0 reads only on /gates.

readyLimits.title: Ready-PR limits
readyLimits.description: Repos or owners that cap how many open, non-draft PRs a contributor without write access may have, as owner=N or owner/repo=N, comma-separated. A green draft there waits instead of asking you to mark it ready while you're at the cap.
